## Où j'en suis
The `noa/rds-pg17` branch stages Terraform changes for a PostgreSQL 17 blue/green upgrade on analytics RDS, starting with staging while leaving production disabled. All provider pins and module adjustments pass `terraform plan` and `tflint`, with a draft PR open for review.

- [en-cours] staging blue/green configuration ready, production template prepared but inactive
- [prochaine-étape] run pg_partman migration on staging, select a valid weekend maintenance window post-signoff
- [essai-raté] AWS provider v6 introduced breaking S3 and EIP changes unrelated to the database upgrade
- [question] optimal switch time that avoids the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock while respecting Maya approval
- [décision] pin AWS provider to ~> 5.82.0 and exclude v6 migration from this PR (source: t04)
- [décision] disable immediate apply and defer production window choice until formal approval (source: t14)
